headline: Activity was enough (Hp30 max 3.3, 0.5 needed in Tromsø), but no aurora in the cameras' checks, several an hour (clouds or moon)
text: Last night: Activity was enough (Hp30 max 3.3, 0.5 needed in Tromsø), but no aurora in the cameras' checks, several an hour (clouds or moon); Tromsø clear 17–04, 05–07, Alta clear 01–03, 04–08
